messages:
ashley: Hey team — draft of a 'fallback matrix' for rollouts is ready. It's a single object describing preferred fallback model/region/capacity tier per policy. Want quick feedback before I add it to console API.
mike: pinged, can you paste the snippet?
ashley: sure:
```yaml
fallback_matrix:
  default:
    priority: ["v2-small", "v1-quantized", "cpu-safe"]
  latency_sensitive:
    max_latency_ms: 120
    priority: ["v2-small", "v2-medium"]
  cost_saver:
    priority: ["v1-quantized", "cpu-safe"]
```
neha: two quick q's: how does this interact with traffic-split guards? if canary fails, do we reroute to baseline or degrade to cheaper model?
ashley: intended flow: guard triggers -> try fallback model in same region -> if capacity error then fallback region -> if still failed then route to baseline with throttled qps. Need opinions.
omar: we should emit structured telemetry for each step: guard_invoked, fallback_attempted{model,region}, fallback_success. otherwise drilldowns are impossible.
sara: agree. also add a metric for 'degraded_response_rate' vs baseline so alerts can catch silent quality regressions.
mike: on the API surface, do we expose full matrix in console or a simplified UI with presets? presets would be safer for users.
ashley: product/console tradeoff flagged. @neha @sara — prefer presets + advanced JSON editor?
neha: presets + advanced editor. Also enforce schema validation server-side.
ashley: what's the alerting rule? propose: when canary ctr delta > 3σ OR degraded_response_rate > 1% for 10m -> auto-failover to baseline and page on-call.
omar: +1 but make failover configurable per customer. Some will want auto-failover off.
deploy-bot: deploy started for service=api-proxy rollout=canary-2026-03-20 by=ashley
mike: one last: quota interplay — fallback to baseline can increase token usage; need quota guard so billing doesn't explode.
ashley: good call. add quota_ceiling param per rollout that prevents fallback if projected cost > ceiling unless explicitly escalated.
sara: added to doc, I'll open PR for telemetry + alert runbook.
neha: I'll prototype UI mock for presets.
ashley: thanks everyone. I'll update the spec and link PR here.
